item.title: github: S3 audit log streaming with OpenID Connect expands to GHE.com
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (GHE.com) now supports streaming enterprise audit logs to Amazon S3 using OpenID Connect (OIDC). This brings the same S3 audit log streaming capability previously available on github.com to GHE.com.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Opt-in dist-tag permissions for npm trusted publishing
item.description:
npm trusted publishing can now optionally get permission to manage dist-tags using short-lived OIDC credentials. This covers actions like moving tags such as latest, next, and beta without using long-lived credentials.

  • Source: GitHub
